g.text: Persistence — one lossless binary container, one lossy portable text form
… one line per entry, in descending frequency order
min_frequency reset to the builder default (1)
Only word and frequency survive; language,
source, created_at and the original N are gone. Re-importing
therefore yields a dictionary whose total_tokens is the sum of the
frequencies — so its log_probs are re-normalised
and no longer agree with the exporter's.
Lines with fewer than two tab-separated fields, or an unparsable
